title: Aajao Ali Akbar
body:
Aa jao ali akbar a s
<<DIVIDER>>
Veeran madine me Sughra ka ye noha hai..Aa jao aliakbar...
Mar jayegi Ro Ro kar beemar ye bahena hai.. Aa jao alikabar..
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum jab se Gaye ghar se dil lagta nahi mera..
Yaadoñ me tadpati hai din Raat teri Sughra..
Furqat ne bhare ghar ki khuñ mujhko rulaya hai.. Aajao aliakbar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Veeran madine me......
<<DIVIDER>>
Muddat se akeli hu koi bhi nahi mera..
Hai yaad mujhey aati baateiñ wo teri bhaiya
Kab aaoge tum lene dil mera dhadakta hai...aajao Aliakbar..
<<DIVIDER>>
Veeran madine me......
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo naksh e qadam tere kal matti pe ubhre the
Mai roz lagati hu Us mitti ko aakhoñ se..
Us ke hi sahare se din mera ghuzarta hai Aajao Aliakbar..
<<DIVIDER>>
Veeran madine me......
<<DIVIDER>>
Wada tha tumhara ye aaoge mujhey lene
Tum aaye nhi kyuker ji paungi mai kaise..
Maloom tumhe bhi hai beemar ye bahna hai Aajao Aliakbar..
<<DIVIDER>>
Veeran madine me......
<<DIVIDER>>
Nanha sa mera bhai ab chalne laga hoga..
Dekha bhi nahi kab se wo hasta hua chehra.
Ab jald se Asgar ko Godi me uthana hai..
Aa jao Aliakbar..
<<DIVIDER>>
Veeran madine me......
<<DIVIDER>>
Masoom sakina ki yaad aa ke rulati hai
Amma ki her ek lamha furqat bhi satati hai
Le jao mujhey unke ab sath hi rahna hai
Aa jao ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Veeran madine me......
<<DIVIDER>>
Khamosh madina hai ghar Qabr ke hai jaisa
Hai aalam e tanhaii dam ghutne laga mera
Lagta hai koi qaidi zindaan me rehta hai...
Aa jao Aliakbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Veeran madine me......
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye soch ke Rote hain Asmee o Turaab aksar
Kis tarha se Zinda hai bhai ke bina khwahar
Is dard e judai me mar jane ka khatra hai
Aa jao ali akbar..
<<DIVIDER>>
Veeran madine me......
author: Asmee Kanodari
